question: With which of the following sports is Aditi Ashok is associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Golf**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Golf is a club and ball sport played on a golf course and the player has to hit the ball into the holes on the ground in the lowest strokes possible. 
 
 
• The long wooden stick used in the sport is called a club.
 
 
 
• **Aditi Ashok, from Bangalore, is an Indian professional golfer. Hence option 4 is correct.**
 
 
• **She represented India in the 2016 Olympics, Rio and 2020 Summer Olympics, Tokyo as well where stood 4th in the rankings.**
 
• She is the only Indian women golfer to feature in the Asian Youth Games, 2013, Asian Games 2014, and Youth Olympic Games 2014.
 
 
 
• She was the youngest and first Indian women golfer to win Ladies European Tour Title in 2016.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tennis is a single or double-player sport played on a rectangular court in which the players have to hit the tennis ball with the racket to the opponent's court.
 
 
• Normally tennis is played on three types of courts Grass, Clay and Hard.
 
• **Leander Paes, Mahesh Bhupathi, and Sania Mirza are some Indian tennis players.**
 
 
 
• Chess is a board game or a strategy game and is played between two players.
 
 
• It contains 64 pieces of black and white colour and is arranged in 8x8 order.
 
• **Viswanath Anand, Koneru Humpy, and Dronavalli Harika are some Indian chess players.**
 
 
 
• Shooting is a competitive sport that happens in shooting ranges (designated facilities for different purposes like competitions).
 
 
• **Abhinav Bindra and Gagan Narang are some noted players.**
